name: double-waves-battle-ropes
instructions:
1. Setup in a good athletic base position with your knees slightly bent, feet shoulder width apart, and hold a rope in each hand.
2. Slam both ropes to the floor utilizing your arms and absorb the impact with your legs.
3. Repeat for the desired time, duration, or reps.
